title: The 1980s Pop Music Quiz
subtitle: Three rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written by claude-sonnet-5 for "1980s Pop Music". NOT YET REVIEWED — read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: Which 1984 charity single kept Wham!'s "Last Christmas" off UK No.1?
options: I Wish It Could Be Christmas Everyday
questions.answerNote: Band Aid's charity single blocked Wham!'s 'Last Christmas' from the top spot in December 1984.

questions.prompt: Which 1982 Michael Jackson album became the best-selling album of all time?
questions.answerNote: Thriller was released in November 1982 and still dominated UK charts through 1983.

questions.prompt: "Every Breath You Take" was a 1983 UK number one for which band?
questions.answerNote: It turned out to be The Police's final UK number one before they split up.

questions.prompt: Which duo topped the UK charts in early 1986 with "West End Girls"?
questions.answerNote: Neil Tennant and Chris Lowe had been a journalist and architecture student before forming the duo.

questions.prompt: Which Frankie Goes to Hollywood single was famously banned by BBC Radio 1 in 1984?
questions.answerNote: DJ Mike Read refused to play 'Relax' on air, which only boosted its sales.

questions.prompt: Culture Club's "Karma Chameleon" was the UK's best-selling single of which year?
questions.answerNote: It topped the UK charts for three weeks in autumn 1983.

questions.prompt: Which Norwegian band had a huge 1985 hit with "Take On Me"?
questions.answerNote: The song's pencil-sketch animated video won six MTV awards in 1986.

questions.prompt: Kylie Minogue's UK number one debut single in 1988 was called what?
questions.answerNote: It launched Kylie's pop career straight after her role in Neighbours.

questions.prompt: Rick Astley topped the UK charts in 1987 with which song?
options: She Wants to Dance with Me
questions.answerNote: The song became internet-famous decades later through 'Rickrolling'.

questions.prompt: Live Aid, featuring Queen's famous Wembley set, was held in which year?
questions.answerNote: Live Aid took place simultaneously at Wembley Stadium and Philadelphia's JFK Stadium.
